name: Crunchy Apple and Cucumber Salad With Sweet Peppers

ingredients.name: granulated sugar, plus more to taste
red pepper flakes, plus more to taste
kosher salt, divided, plus more to taste
Pink Lady apples, cored and cut into 1/2-inch pieces
finely chopped fresh cilantro leaves, basil, mint, or dill

instructions.primary_message: In a large bowl, combine cucumber pieces and reserved seeds, scallion whites, sugar, red pepper flakes, 2 tablespoons rice vinegar, and 1 teaspoon kosher salt. Stir until evenly combined and let sit at room temperature until water is released from cucumbers, about 10 minutes.
Add apples, bell pepper, herbs, jalapeño, and scallion greens and toss to combine.
In a small bowl, combine olive oil, remaining 2 tablespoons rice vinegar, and remaining 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt. Whisk until combined.

Whisk dressing to recombine if necessary, then pour over salad and toss until evenly coated. Let salad sit at room temperature until flavors meld, about 15 minutes. Serve at room temperature, lightly chilled, or cold.

schema_metadata.keywords: apple cucumber salad, apple salad, cucumber salad, apple pepper salad, fall salad

description: This crunchy, juicy salad pairs crisp apple and cucumber with sweet peppers, fresh herbs, chiles, and a bright rice vinegar dressing.
notes:
Optional substitutions: red bell pepper → green bell pepper or yellow bell pepper or orange bell pepper

Notes: Other firm, crisp apple varieties, such as Honeycrisp, Fuji, or Braeburn, can be substituted for the Pink Lady apples.
A serrano or Thai green chile can be substituted for the jalapeño; adjust the amount to taste. For more heat, leave the seeds and ribs intact; for less, remove them before mincing.

Make-ahead and storage: Refrigerate leftovers in an airtight container for up to 4 days.
author: Ozoz Sokoh
